jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 건축물 정기점검이력 lane `building-maintenance-regular-inspection-history` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0402, ADR-0404): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_maintenance_regular_inspection_history already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, compare it, in the publisher's DuckDB, with the table's current rows in one piece and append to main only the new rows and a removal marker per vanished one (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). Two of the duckdb pool's runs go at a time, lanes or other in-process work: each holds one of its slots and a memory_claim on its unit (root ADR-0599, ADR-0605).
jobs.memory_measured: 2026-11-21, building-register-units. Under 16G: three runs, export 6m47s-7m00s CPU and about 10 minutes of wall time, `memory peak` 13.3-13.4G. Under the 8G this cap was for one day: one run, 61 minutes (17:37:58-18:39:25Z), 10m35s CPU, `memory peak` 7.2G - the export child held 6.68G resident and the cgroup sat at MemoryHigh with 18,933 `high` events and no OOM kill: throttled, not killed. journal `memory peak` 2026-10-18..11-08, 84 runs under 16G: highest 15,668M on 2026-10-20 (building-register-unit-areas). The other lanes measured on the DuckDB path the same day: 0.3G-7.1G.
jobs.memory_headroom_why: A measured working point, not 1.5 x a peak: the export sizes its workers to three quarters of what its cgroup has left, so its peak follows the cap, but about 7G of it does not shrink - at 8G nothing was left for it to work in. 16G is the cap under which the largest export is measured to finish in ten minutes. One number for all 54 lanes, because they share one unit template: it over-reserves for the small lanes (1-7G), and a request per lane comes with the Dagster resource tags that replace this admission (root ADR-0583 follow-up).
jobs.disk_measured: not measured: no silver-refresh.sh report in the unit's journal 2026-10-12..11-26; 2G is the computed floor of a Silver release copy, its stage database and staged files. The stage logs `duckdb stage closed: disk_bytes=<n>` as it closes (root ADR-0622); a pull request replaces this bound with the highest logged value, nothing is kept between runs.

first_run.estimated_from: computed, about 2.5x the nearest larger measured neighbours on the same template unit (root ADR-0386): silver_refresh_building_permit_basis_outline 357 s for a 438 MB release, _parking 251 s for 59 MB, _demolition_loss 161 s for 15 MB; this lane's newest release is about 2 MB in the Bronze ledger (2026-11-09)

expected_outcome.basis: building HUB files are released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h, in the endpoint catalog) plus one daily fallback; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): changed once, on its first load.

assets.title: 건축물 정기점검이력
assets.description: 정기점검이 다룬 건물마다 한 행: 점검실시PK, 관리건축물대장PK, 점검기관, 점검시작일, 처리일자. 대지구분 칸이 없어 pnu 를 짓지 않는다; 읽는 쪽이 관리건축물대장PK 로 표제부(silver.building_register_titles) 현재 행에 이어 그 pnu 를 쓴다(루트 ADR-0404). 원문 11칸 보존. 필지 by-PNU 종류 parcel-building-permits 가 그 표제부의 PNU 로 필지 문서의 목록 하나로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0402, ADR-0404, ADR-0464).

dependencies.description: 건축물 정기점검이력(mart_ll_02) 11칸을 행 글자 키로 새 행·사라진 행만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다. pnu 칸은 없다: 필지는 관리건축물대장PK 를 표제부 현재 행에 읽을 때 이어 얻는다(표제부 키 = <네 자리 기관 코드>||'1'||<일련번호>, 같은 시군구 또는 같은 법정동·번·지; 표본 2,000 행 94.7%) — 적재 때 고정하지 않으므로 표제부 pnu 의 재조합·코드 변경을 따라간다(루트 ADR-0404, ADR-0329).
